topic.title: Arts: Why It Helps in Neighbourhood Arts Festivals

candidate_instructions: Read all five sections. Answer Questions 1-5. Follow the stated word limits exactly.

sections.heading: The Story
sections.text: People get great benefits from this arts project. They learn new skills. They feel better and happier..

sections.heading: How It Works
sections.text: But there are some problems too. It takes time and effort. Some people find it hard..

sections.heading: People's Stories
sections.text: People's health gets better. They are less worried. They sleep better and feel good..

sections.heading: Good and Bad
sections.text: People get better jobs. They make more money. Their lives improve a lot..

sections.heading: The Future
sections.text: The benefits are worth the effort. Everyone is happier. Families are stronger. The community is better..
